summary: @servicetitan/cp-mfe-dev preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated math_init.js payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime archive from a GitHub oven-sh/bun release URL, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods the binary executable, and then invokes it via execFileSync against a shipped 728 KB obfuscated bundle named math_init.js. math_init.js is a Bun-compiled artifact (// @bun @bun-cjs header) with obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation (WV8StW rotator, n7gIxM string array, hc1jfK9 decoder) that hides all string literals — including any URLs, filesystem paths, and API names — behind a runtime decoder. The package's advertised purpose is a React micro-frontend dev harness; there is no functional reason for that purpose to require a second language runtime or an opaque bundled payload at install time. Installing the package auto-executes this payload under a freshly downloaded runtime that Node-based scanners do not inspect.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
